title: Rustfall
desc: Our biggest game: a post-apocalyptic roguelite. Survive the wasteland, fight through the biomes, mutate and push each run as deep as you can.

title: Echo's Swim
desc: Flappy Bird, but Echo is an axolotl: tap to swim up, glide through the coral gates, collect bubbles and beat your best swim.

title: Nova Siege
desc: A remastered retro pixel shooter: dodge the swarm, blast the galactic army, beat stage bosses, then bank credits to permanently upgrade your ship and unlock new hulls.

title: Arcane Citadel
desc: Two ways to hold the Citadel with Ember: a Quick Night (three waves, then Malgrath) or a Deep Night (endless waves, a boss every five, the full upgrade shop).

title: Tower Defence
desc: Build a kingdom through the ages and hold back the endless night: place defenders, upgrade them and survive each wave.

title: Ember Smash: Brick Forge
desc: Ember's brick breaker: slide the forge paddle, keep the spark alive and smash glowing bricks through six forges.

title: Gem Match
desc: A focused two-minute match-3 score attack: fire cascades, build bombs and wild gems, hit fever mode and push your best score as high as it goes.

title: Highway Dodge
desc: Swerve through oncoming traffic at high speed. There is always a gap, so chain near-misses for combo points, collect fuel and coins, then spend them on new cars and upgrades in the garage.

title: Sky High With Friends
desc: Solo sky-high climbing. Bounce Squirt the axolotl up the tower, ride gusts, grab coins and beat your best height.

title: Critter Whack: Ranger Sort
desc: Read the ranger clue, then tap only the critters that fit the habitat, movement or behaviour. Quick sorting fun, but watch out for hazards.

title: Crossy Crew
desc: Pip and Echo, brother and sister, lead the crew across busy roads and rushing rivers. Hop forward, dodge the traffic, ride the logs and see how far the crew can get.

title: Lumo's Hive Strike
desc: A tactical formation defence. Break the Hive's linked clusters, bank honey, draft garden boons and build honey turrets between waves, then topple a three-phase queen.

title: Lumo's Firefly Shooter
desc: A cosy hex match puzzle. Launch firefly bubbles into the hanging garden, match three or more colours, rescue fireflies and keep the shadow rows away from Lumo's lantern.

title: Stardust Snake
desc: Classic snake in a night sky: steer a trail of stardust into the fallen stars, grow your constellation and never drift into the edge or your own light.

title: Pip's Cozy Cove
desc: A calm fishing game with Pip the little turtle: charge your cast, aim for ripples and reel with care. Choose or craft bait, follow the tide, unlock new areas, meet Moonfin, keep fish in the aquarium, decorate the cove and save a postcard or catch card. Gentle mode turns reeling into a tap.

title: Call of the Cards
desc: A quick card duel: recruit companions, play tricks and hold 8 Power at the start of your turn, then storm the Fortress. Three to five minutes, one crown.
